business.description: Zee Learn Limited is a leading education company committed to transforming learning and contributing to nation-building through education. It operates a diverse ecosystem spanning early childhood (Kidzee), K-12 schooling (Mount Litera Zee Schools, Mount Litera School International), and creative arts & skill development (ZICA, ZIMA).

outlook.statement: During FY27, plan to extend the footprint of Mount Litera Zee Schools across Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets, accelerate the growth of Znius towards its stated milestones and extend the parent portal beyond its current pilot locations.

Five-module AI training programme for employees continues into FY27, alongside the rollout of new internal applications that automate administrative processes, improve collaboration across teams and enhance overall operational efficiency.

Priorities remain clear: executing with consistency, deepening engagement across education platforms and building growth that is both sustainable and meaningful. Will continue to invest in expanding network thoughtfully, using technology to enhance operations and upholding strong governance standards.

The Indian education sector remains positive, driven by sustained policy support, rising investments in digital and academic infrastructure, favourable demographics and increasing demand for quality education. Continued implementation of NEP 2020, expansion of technology-enabled learning frameworks and stronger focus on foundational literacy, employability and skill development are expected to support long-term sectoral growth.

Indian economy remains positive, with India expected to continue as one of the fastest-growing major economies globally. Real GDP growth for FY 2026-27 is projected at 6.6%, supported by resilient domestic demand, continued government capital expenditure and gradual recovery in private consumption.

Indian preschool industry is expected to maintain a positive growth momentum driven by favourable demographics, policy-level emphasis on foundational education and rising awareness regarding structured child development. Increasing expansion into Tier II and Tier III cities, stronger franchise-led growth models and rising adoption of technology-enabled learning platforms are expected to support industry scalability and accessibility.

India's K-12 education industry remains constructive over the medium term, driven by favourable demographics, policy-led reforms and rising investments in digital and experiential learning ecosystems. Increasing adoption of personalised learning solutions, expansion of international and blended curriculum models and deeper integration of artificial intelligence and data-driven teaching methodologies.

Going forward, the Company will pursue an asset-light, franchise-led growth model, with emphasis on network expansion, centre-level productivity and stronger franchise-partner support, particularly across Tier-2 and Tier-3 markets. Technology, AI and digital transformation will remain key enablers, including the development of a unified cloud-based ecosystem, enhanced parent engagement solutions and scaling of Znius as a technology-led curriculum and school management platform. The Company will also explore opportunities in creative and vocational education and other emerging education solutions to diversify revenue streams.

The Company has secured new business opportunities during the current financial year, which is expected to contribute positively to operational performance. The Company's business plan for the next financial year, as approved by the Board of Directors, exhibits higher growth in revenues, higher capacity utilisation and better product mix, resulting in improved profitability and increasing operational cash flows.
Management expect that 100% of the transaction price allocated to the unsatisfied contracts as of 31 March 2026 (Rs 8,443.54 lakhs) will be recognised as revenue during the year ended 31 March 2027.
